scholarship.title: Academic Scholarship
scholarship.description: The Pasig City Merit Scholarship Program provides financial assistance to academically-gifted students residing in Pasig City.

eligibility.item: Must be a bonafide resident of Pasig City
Must have a general weighted average of at least 85%
Combined family income must not exceed ₱350,000 annually

requirements.item: Proof of residency in Pasig City

benefits.coverage: Full tuition fee coverage, monthly stipend, and book allowance

scholarship.title: Private School-Endorsed Scholarship
scholarship.description: A partnership-based scholarship for students endorsed by accredited private schools in Pasig City.

eligibility.item: Pasig residents endorsed by partner private schools

requirements.item: Essay: "Why do you want to be a scholar of Pasig City?"

benefits.coverage: Partial tuition subsidy and educational supplies support

scholarship.title: Sports Scholarship
scholarship.description: A scholarship designed to support student-athletes who have brought honor to the city through sports.

benefits.coverage: Tuition assistance, athletic training support, and travel allowances for competitions

scholarship.title: Financial Assistance for Bar & Board Licensure Examinations
scholarship.description: Financial aid to help Pasig graduates cover costs related to taking licensure exams.

requirements.item: Notice of Admission from PRC/Supreme Court/MARINA

benefits.coverage: Exam registration fee coverage and review material support

scholarship.title: Incentives for College Honor Graduates
scholarship.description: A one-time cash incentive for Pasig scholars who graduate with Latin honors.

eligibility.item: Pasig City scholars graduating with Latin honors

benefits.coverage: Cash incentive based on level of honors

scholarship.title: Scholarship for Sangguniang Kabataan Officials
scholarship.description: This scholarship supports active SK officials who are continuing their academic journey.

benefits.coverage: Tuition fee subsidy and leadership training allowance

scholarship.title: Out-of-School Learners Scholarship
scholarship.description: A program for ALS graduates looking to pursue senior high school or college education.

benefits.coverage: School supplies, tuition assistance, and monthly stipend

scholarship.title: CHIP-in (Continuing High School Program for Education) Scholarship
scholarship.description: Helps students who have stopped schooling return and complete their high school education.

eligibility.item: Students returning to complete high school education

requirements.item: Proof of income or Certificate of Indigency

benefits.coverage: Free school materials, daily meal allowance, and uniform subsidy
